# HVE pattern notice

This accelerator is informed by Microsoft HVE Core patterns, especially Research, Plan, Implement, Review; durable handoffs; specialist review; and the principle that AI carries rules while humans retain judgment.

It does not vendor the complete HVE Core framework and is not runtime-dependent on it. Before adapting a specific upstream file, record the source repository, commit/tag, original path, licence, adaptation and review date.

Upstream: <https://github.com/microsoft/hve-core>
